meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 激活后,Claude 会按「先找证据,再下结论」的方式排查程序故障:先形成至少三个猜测并同时验证,找到真正原因后,先用一个会失败的测试锁定问题,再做最小修复,最后实际运行程序确认修好,并清理调试痕迹。
howto.when: 当你说「debug this」「为什么 X 不工作」「程序卡住」等触发词,或要求排查程序运行时故障时,会进入调试流程。

say.text: 帮我调试一段 Python 程序,它崩溃了没报错。
say.note: 它会先读 Python 运行时参考,再开始找证据。

say.text: 这个接口返回 HTTP 200 但是内容为空,查一下原因。
say.note: 它会按假设驱动流程排查静默失败。

say.text: 用 Playwright 复现这个浏览器的点击 bug。
say.note: 它会驱动真实浏览器做运行验证。

howto.what_en: After activation, Claude becomes an evidence-driven debugger: it forms at least three hypotheses, investigates in parallel, confirms the root cause with a failing test, applies a minimal fix, then actually runs the system to verify and cleans up artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to debug a runtime problem, mention trigger phrases like "debug this", "why is X not working", "hanging", or request attaching a debugger or reverse engineering.

say_en.text: Help me debug a Python program that crashes silently.
say_en.note: It will read the Python runtime reference first.

say_en.text: This API returns HTTP 200 but empty body. Find out why.
say_en.note: It will investigate silent failure with evidence.

say_en.text: Reproduce this browser click bug with Playwright.
say_en.note: It will drive a real browser for QA.
